title: Risk of people and computers
intro: The risk score is the sum of points for a person's or computer's alerts: by alert level, decaying over time, with a multiplier for privileged accounts and critical computers. Many small alerts, none dangerous on its own, together form a signal. Alerts resolved as a false positive or legitimate activity do not count. siem-detector recalculates the scores every 5 minutes.
disabled: Risk scoring is disabled in the settings.
empty: No scores – nobody has alerts that count towards risk.

detail.intro: The largest contributions (points after decay and the multiplier). Resolving an alert as a false positive or legitimate activity removes it from the score at the next recalculation.

settings.title: Scoring settings
settings.enabledHelp: Disabling removes the scores at the next recalculation.

resolution.label: Resolution
resolution.help: False positives and legitimate activity do not count towards the risk of a person or computer.

hint.true_positive: a threat or a policy violation – counts towards risk
hint.benign: real but authorized (e.g. announced administrator work) – does not count
hint.false_positive: the rule fired incorrectly – does not count

gdpr: Ranking employees by risk is profiling under the GDPR: agree its use with your data protection officer, grant access only to those who need it (the “Risk of people and computers” permission), and treat the score as a pointer for analysis, not an assessment of the person.
